22253.context: And they're getting into occult practices and they're exploring their own intuition and their own beliefs and their own rituals, and I love it and I love to see it. And what I love more than anything else in the work that I do with with people in religious deconstruction is restoring this mother-daughter relationship. Like I symbolically imagine women for 10,000 years binding the feet of their daughters to help them survive in patriarchy until this generation.
